---
title: "Lock and Synchronize R Packages"
subtitle: "Keep project packages separate from the immutable runtime"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

`uvr.toml` declares direct R requirements and `uvr.lock` records their resolved
versions. The SIF supplies the stable R ABI and the `uvr` executable. At
runtime, `uvr` owns its project library, cache, R-version resolution, and
activation files; the container and runner do not override them.

The direct declaration covers the implemented pipeline and the reviewed
stage 5–7 spatial workflow. The following survey parsed all ten top-level
legacy R scripts at commit `31e0769683e133e136b09ac0c6608c5a12657a9a`, including
namespaced calls and `999_utility_functions.R`. Comments and checkpoint copies
are not executable dependencies.

| Legacy evidence | Required packages and migration treatment |
| --- | --- |
| Stages 0–7: `tidyverse`, `magrittr`, CSV/Excel readers | Declare the used members `dplyr`, `ggplot2`, `purrr`, `readr`, `stringr`, `tibble`, `tidyr`, plus `magrittr` and `readxl`; avoid requiring the entire `tidyverse` bundle |
| Stages 0, 2–4A: `data.table`, `rlang`, `stringi` | Retain as explicit requirements, including legacy replication fixtures |
| Stage 0 imports `openxlsx`; page 18 still imports it | Declare `openxlsx` even though the legacy script does not call its readers |
| Stages 5–7: `sf` | Geometry I/O, validity repair, unions, relations, areas, CRS, containment, and centroids |
| Stage 5: `igraph` | `graph_from_adjacency_matrix()` and `components()` for contiguity diagnostics |
| Shared utility: `fuzzyjoin`; stage 6: `stringdist` | Grouped cosine string-distance joins and clinic-name matching; declare both explicitly |
| Stage 5: `tmap`, `ggpubr`, `MetBrewer`, `ggplot2` | Reviewed map diagnostics, plot assembly/export, and palettes; retained for the planned plot-list targets |
| Stage 3: `gtranslate` | Replaced by the recorded translation artifact in S3; do not introduce live translation into targets |
| Stages 4A, 5, 7: `feather` | Migrated tabular artifacts use DuckDB/Parquet; `sf` targets retain geometry. No standalone `feather` or Arrow C++ runtime is required |
| Stage 4A: `furrr`, `parallel` | `targets` owns execution; no nested futures. `parallel` is supplied with R |
| Every main script: `rstudioapi` | IDE working-directory setup is replaced by the runner and project paths |
| `data_checks.R`: `diffdf` | Legacy scratch comparison only; maintained checks use explicit schema/value comparisons |
| Commented `ggsflabel` calls | Excluded; no active reference in the reviewed scripts |

The lock resolves transitive packages such as `stars`, `tmaptools`, and
raster dependencies of mapping packages; they are not all promoted to direct
requirements. `units` and `s2` are direct requirements because the runtime
acceptance check exercises them explicitly. Native dependencies belong in
[Spack](12_page-jinja.qmd), not in this package list. The pinned legacy
mapping calls use tmap v3 syntax; migrating those diagnostics to the resolved
tmap API and checking their meaning is stage-5 implementation work, not a
reason to pin an untested old mapping stack here.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm The Direct Dependencies"}

Review the dependency list below. A dependency belongs here only when Manual or
pipeline code imports it. `data.table` also supports the synthetic S4
replication checks against the pinned legacy monthly function.
Rebuild the native image before resolving/installing the spatial closure.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Resolve And Synchronize In The Container"}

```sh
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec uvr lock

# One-time migration for an existing binary library; preserve it for rollback.
# Repeat after a native ABI change, with R sessions stopped.
if test -d .uvr/library; then
  backup=".uvr/cache/library-before-source-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
  test ! -e "$backup"
  mkdir -p .uvr/cache
  mv .uvr/library "$backup"
fi

# Namespace compiled packages by the image's concrete native environment.
native_lock_sha=$(scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec \
  sha256sum /opt/spack-environment/spack.lock | awk '{print $1}')
test "${#native_lock_sha}" -eq 64
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec env \
  UVR_PACKAGES_DIR="/work/.uvr/cache/spack-packages/${native_lock_sha}" \
  uvr sync --frozen --no-binary
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec uvr activate --write-shim
```

Source builds are the accepted policy for this Spack runtime. The source flag
is supported by the pinned `uvr` 0.4.6. Its implementation first skips packages
already installed at the locked version, even with `--no-binary` or
`--ignore-cache`. Preserving and replacing the existing library is therefore
necessary for the initial binary-to-source migration.

The documented `UVR_PACKAGES_DIR` override is scoped to this installation
command: it isolates compiled source-cache entries by native lock hash without
changing the image, runner, activation, default project library, download cache,
or another project's packages. uvr's source cache key includes R/version/source
identity but not the full GDAL/GEOS/PROJ build. A separate cache namespace is
needed after native ABI changes; do not delete the shared global cache or
create compatibility SONAME symlinks. Reuse the same command, native lock hash,
and `--no-binary` for later synchronization; routine syncs do not need the
library-backup step.

These behaviors were checked against the pinned
[sync implementation](https://github.com/nbafrank/uvr/blob/v0.4.6/crates/uvr/src/commands/sync.rs),
[cache key](https://github.com/nbafrank/uvr/blob/v0.4.6/crates/uvr-core/src/installer/package_cache.rs),
and [supported environment variables](https://github.com/nbafrank/uvr/blob/v0.4.6/crates/uvr-core/src/env_vars.rs).

Commit `uvr.lock` only after successful resolution through the built runtime.
Use `uvr r pin` only when an additional exact `.r-version` pin is intentional;
do not generate that optional file outside `uvr`.

Run scripts through `uvr run`. For an interactive session, enter the container
shell and source `.uvr/activate`; that shim asks `uvr` to resolve the current
project environment instead of storing hard-coded paths.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Recover An Incomplete Compiled Package"}

`shared object 'duckdb.so' not found` identifies the R package's own compiled
module. A successful source installation of `duckdb` produces that module
and installs the R code alongside it. Adding a Spack DuckDB CLI or a separate
`libduckdb.so` does not install the R bindings. This differs from a missing
`libudunits2.so.0`, which is an external dependency of an existing R module.

The observed `duckdb` 2.0.0 directory contained `DESCRIPTION`, an empty
`libs/`, and no `R/`. That is an incomplete installation, not evidence of a
missing native Spack root. uvr 0.4.6's version-only installed-package check
can skip this directory and fail later when compiling `duckplyr`. Its source
installer also disables staged installation and the final load test. Retain
the failed package and the earlier compilation log before retrying; the
downstream error does not establish why the earlier build stopped.

With no installer or R session using the library, recover just the incomplete
package, then synchronize from the existing lock. This does not re-resolve
versions or clear the shared package cache:

```sh
broken=".uvr/cache/duckdb-incomplete-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
test ! -e "$broken"
mkdir -p .uvr/cache
mv .uvr/library/duckdb "$broken"
native_lock_sha=$(scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec \
  sha256sum /opt/spack-environment/spack.lock | awk '{print $1}')
test "${#native_lock_sha}" -eq 64
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec env \
  UVR_PACKAGES_DIR="/work/.uvr/cache/spack-packages/${native_lock_sha}" \
  MAKEFLAGS=-j1 uvr sync --frozen --no-binary --ignore-cache --timeout 2h
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript scripts/check-tabular-runtime.R
```

DuckDB compiles a substantial C++ engine. The recovery uses one compiler job
and an explicit timeout to limit concurrent build memory and allow the build
to finish. If it fails, inspect the first compiler/linker error in the DuckDB
install log before retrying or changing infrastructure. For an isolated
diagnostic build, `R CMD INSTALL --library=<temporary-library> <locked-source>`
uses R's default staged installation and load tests; validate it before
promoting its package directory into the project library.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-source-r file="{{ emit.project_root }}/scripts/check-tabular-runtime.R" title="Emit The DuckDB And Parquet Runtime Check"}

This checks the installed R module before loading either namespace, then
executes a grouped SQL query through duckplyr and round-trips a synthetic
Parquet file. It reads no research data or targets store.

```r
# Run through scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript.
local({
  package <- find.package("duckdb", quiet = TRUE)
  if (!length(package)) stop("The duckdb R package is not installed.")
  module <- file.path(package, "libs", paste0("duckdb", .Platform$dynlib.ext))
  if (!file.exists(module)) {
    stop("Incomplete duckdb R installation: missing ", module,
         ". Reinstall the locked R package; see infrastructure page 14.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  loadNamespace("duckdb")
  loadNamespace("duckplyr")
  cat("duckdb:", as.character(utils::packageVersion("duckdb")), "\n")
  cat("duckplyr:", as.character(utils::packageVersion("duckplyr")), "\n")
  cat("Module:", normalizePath(module), "\n")
  source <- duckplyr::read_sql_duckdb(
    "SELECT k, sum(v) AS total FROM (VALUES ('a',1.5),('a',2.5),('b',NULL::DOUBLE)) t(k,v) GROUP BY k ORDER BY k",
    prudence = "stingy")
  output <- tempfile("duckdb-runtime-", fileext = ".parquet")
  on.exit(unlink(output), add = TRUE)
  duckplyr::compute_parquet(source, output)
  actual <- duckplyr::read_parquet_duckdb(output, prudence = "stingy") |>
    dplyr::collect() |>
    dplyr::arrange(k)
  stopifnot(identical(actual$k, c("a", "b")),
            identical(actual$total, c(4, NA_real_)))
  message("Tabular runtime accepted: DuckDB R module, duckplyr SQL, and Parquet round trip.")
})
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-source-r file="{{ emit.project_root }}/scripts/check-geospatial-runtime.R" title="Emit The Synthetic Spatial Runtime Check"}

Run this after source synchronization. It reads no research inputs and does
not build targets. It reports package/engine versions and s2 state, tests
unit conversion, GEOS repair/union/relations, graph components, CRS round trips,
spherical area, GDAL shapefile/GeoPackage I/O, fuzzy matching, and headless map
exports. The temporary GeoPackage only checks the SQLite-enabled driver; it
does not establish a new pipeline artifact format. Scientific parity and
legacy tmap-call migration remain separate stage-5 tests.

```r
# Run through scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript.
# Synthetic runtime acceptance only: no staged data or targets store access.
local({
  required <- c("sf", "units", "s2", "igraph", "fuzzyjoin", "stringdist",
                "ggplot2", "ggpubr", "MetBrewer", "tmap", "readxl")
  failures <- vapply(required, function(package) {
    tryCatch({ loadNamespace(package); "" }, error = conditionMessage)
  }, character(1))
  if (any(nzchar(failures))) {
    stop("Geospatial runtime is not ready:\n",
         paste(names(failures)[nzchar(failures)], failures[nzchar(failures)],
               sep = ": ", collapse = "\n"), call. = FALSE)
  }
  print(data.frame(package = required,
                   version = vapply(required, function(p) as.character(utils::packageVersion(p)), character(1))))
  print(sf::sf_extSoftVersion())
  cat("sf_use_s2:", sf::sf_use_s2(), "\n")
  cat("UDUNITS2_XML_PATH:", Sys.getenv("UDUNITS2_XML_PATH"), "\n")
  stopifnot(as.numeric(units::set_units(units::set_units(1, "km"), "m")) == 1000)

  scratch <- tempfile("geospatial-runtime-")
  dir.create(scratch)
  on.exit(unlink(scratch, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  geometry <- sf::st_as_sfc(c(
    "POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))",
    "POLYGON ((1 0, 2 0, 2 1, 1 1, 1 0))",
    "POLYGON ((4 0, 5 0, 5 1, 4 1, 4 0))"
  ), crs = 3857)
  shapes <- sf::st_sf(id = 1:3, geometry = geometry)
  stopifnot(all(sf::st_is_valid(shapes)),
            abs(as.numeric(sf::st_area(sf::st_union(geometry))) - 3) < 1e-8)
  adjacency <- sf::st_relate(geometry, pattern = "F***1****", sparse = FALSE)
  graph <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adjacency, mode = "undirected")
  stopifnot(igraph::components(graph)$no == 2L)
  bowtie <- sf::st_as_sfc("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 1, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0))", crs = 3857)
  stopifnot(all(sf::st_is_valid(sf::st_make_valid(bowtie))))

  point <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_point(c(47, -19)), crs = 4326)
  back <- sf::st_transform(sf::st_transform(point, 32738), 4326)
  stopifnot(max(abs(sf::st_coordinates(back) - sf::st_coordinates(point))) < 1e-6)
  spherical <- s2::s2_geog_from_text("POLYGON ((47 -19, 48 -19, 48 -18, 47 -18, 47 -19))")
  stopifnot(is.finite(s2::s2_area(spherical)), s2::s2_area(spherical) > 0)
  for (extension in c("shp", "gpkg")) {
    path <- file.path(scratch, paste0("shapes.", extension))
    sf::st_write(shapes, path, quiet = TRUE)
    restored <- sf::st_read(path, quiet = TRUE)
    stopifnot(nrow(restored) == 3L, sf::st_crs(restored) == sf::st_crs(shapes),
              all(sf::st_equals(restored, shapes, sparse = FALSE)[cbind(1:3, 1:3)]))
  }
  matched <- fuzzyjoin::stringdist_inner_join(
    data.frame(name = "Ambato"), data.frame(name = "Ambato"),
    by = "name", method = "cosine", max_dist = 0)
  stopifnot(nrow(matched) == 1L,
            stringdist::stringdist("Ambato", "Ambato", method = "cosine") == 0)

  stopifnot(capabilities("cairo"))
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(shapes) + ggplot2::geom_sf(
    ggplot2::aes(fill = factor(id))) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = MetBrewer::met.brewer("Renoir", 3))
  png <- file.path(scratch, "geometry.png")
  ggplot2::ggsave(png, ggpubr::ggarrange(plot, plot, ncol = 2),
                 width = 6, height = 3, device = "png", type = "cairo")
  map <- tmap::tm_shape(shapes) + tmap::tm_polygons()
  map_png <- file.path(scratch, "map.png")
  tmap::tmap_save(map, map_png, width = 4, height = 3, units = "in")
  stopifnot(file.info(png)$size > 0, file.info(map_png)$size > 0)
  message("Geospatial runtime accepted: units, GEOS, PROJ, s2, GDAL I/O, graph/matching, and headless maps.")
})
```

```sh
test -f uvr.toml
rg -n '^r_version = "4.5.1"|^targets =|^tarchetypes =' uvr.toml
test -f uvr.lock
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec env \
  UVR_PACKAGES_DIR="/work/.uvr/cache/spack-packages/${native_lock_sha}" \
  uvr sync --frozen --no-binary
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript -e 'library(targets)'
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript scripts/check-tabular-runtime.R
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript scripts/check-geospatial-runtime.R
```
